column3: Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew describes the speakers as the king’s young men, his servants; BSB calls them attendants.
The Hebrew calls the place the house of the women and repeats young virgin; BSB uses harem and young women.
The Hebrew repeats the image of being good in the king’s eyes; BSB renders this as pleasing him.
